name: Global most played (PC)
metric: Estimated PC hours played in the last 30 days, in millions
method: Steam: steamcharts.com 30-day hours (official chart API for games it misses). Games mostly played through other launchers get a launcher factor; games not on Steam get an estimate from the sources below. Each game keeps its top SteamSpy tags; vibes are derived from them. Tools, idle games, adult games, demos and servers are excluded.

sources.label: Steam official charts API (most played, concurrent)
Newzoo top PC games by MAU, 2025 (via Gigazine)
DemandSage: most played games right now
LinuxBuz: PC games by monthly users
Shane the Gamer: most played video games statistics
